description_en: Modifies the binding items of a forwarding rule
description_zh: 修改转发策略绑定项目
name: ModifyForwardStrategyBindingItems

parameters.help_en:
The policy matching target type. Required. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: associates with all users.
UserGroupNormal: associates with specific user groups.
ApplicationAll: all private network applications.
Application: specific private network applications.
Tag: private network application tags.

When the value is UserGroupAll or ApplicationAll, ItemIds must be empty. When the value is UserGroupNormal, Application, or Tag, ItemIds is required.

When ModifyType is not Cover, switching the matching target type is not allowed: Application, Tag, and ApplicationAll are mutually exclusive, and UserGroupNormal and UserGroupAll are mutually exclusive. If a binding item of a mutually exclusive type already exists on the same forwarding rule, the request is rejected
parameters.help_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。必填。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组。
ApplicationAll: 所有内网应用。
Application: 部分内网应用。
Tag: 内网应用标签。

取值为 UserGroupAll 或 ApplicationAll 时，ItemIds 必须为空；取值为 UserGroupNormal、Application 或 Tag 时，ItemIds 必填。

ModifyType 不为 Cover 时不允许切换匹配目标类型：Application、Tag、ApplicationAll 三者互斥，UserGroupNormal 与 UserGroupAll 互斥。同一转发策略上已存在互斥类型的绑定项时，请求会被拒绝
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en:
The modification method. Required. Valid values:
Append: appends to existing binding items. ItemIds cannot contain objects that are already bound.
Delete: deletes specified binding items. All objects in ItemIds must be already bound.
Cover: overwrites binding items of the same category by clearing all existing binding items of the same category on the forwarding rule and then writing ItemIds. The same category refers to ApplicationAll, Application, and Tag, or UserGroupAll and UserGroupNormal.

When the value is Append or Delete, MatchMode cannot be UserGroupAll or ApplicationAll
parameters.help_zh:
修改方式。必填。取值：
Append：在现有绑定项上追加。ItemIds 中不能包含已绑定的对象。
Delete：删除指定的绑定项。ItemIds 中必须全部为已绑定的对象。
Cover：覆盖同类绑定项，即先清空该转发策略上同类的全部绑定项，再写入 ItemIds。同类范围为 ApplicationAll、Application、Tag，或 UserGroupAll、UserGroupNormal。

取值为 Append 或 Delete 时，MatchMode 不能为 UserGroupAll 或 ApplicationAll
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en: The list of binding item IDs. Must be empty when MatchMode is UserGroupAll or ApplicationAll. Required for other values. Duplicates are not allowed in the list, and the specified objects must already exist
parameters.help_zh: 绑定项ID列表。MatchMode 为 UserGroupAll 或 ApplicationAll 时必须为空，其余取值时必填。列表内不允许重复，且所指定的对象必须已存在
parameters.name: item_ids

ForwardStrategyBindingItems.description_en: The binding items of the forwarding rule after this modification
ForwardStrategyBindingItems.description_zh: 本次修改后该转发策略的绑定项

Items.description_en: The binding content. This parameter is not returned when MatchMode is UserGroupAll or ApplicationAll
Items.description_zh: 绑定内容。MatchMode 为 UserGroupAll 或 ApplicationAll 时不返回该参数
